context: RV64I load and store instructions include LD for 64-bit loads, LW and LWU for 32-bit sign-extended and zero-extended loads, LH/LHU and LB/LBU for 16-bit and 8-bit loads, and SD, SW, SH, SB for storing 64-, 32-, 16-, and 8-bit values from rs2 to memory.

|imm[11:0]|rs1|funct3|rd|opcode| |---|---|---|---|---| |imm[11:5]|rs2|rs1|funct3|imm[4:0]|opcode| |---|---|---|---|---|---| The LD instruction loads a 64-bit value from memory into register _rd_ for RV64I. The LW instruction loads a 32-bit value from memory and sign-extends this to 64 bits before storing it in register _rd_ for RV64I. The LWU instruction, on the other hand, zero-extends the 32-bit value from memory for RV64I. LH and LHU are defined analogously for 16-bit values, as are LB and LBU for 8-bit values. The SD, SW, SH, and SB instructions store 64-bit, 32-bit, 16-bit, and 8-bit values from the low bits of register _rs2_ to memory respectively.
